# UTAAB

> UTAAB is a student-led Web3 ecosystem for blockchain education, real projects, and cross-border collaboration — from first guide to first shipped project.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of UTAAB's community, education, and projects.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, and what we do.
- [Team](/team): Founders, contributors, and advisors.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about UTAAB, membership, and Web3 basics.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles, updates, and field notes from the community.
- [Learn Hub](/learn): Entry point for guides and workshops.
- [Guides](/learn/guides): Beginner-to-advanced blockchain learning material.
- [Workshops](/learn/workshops): Live and recorded workshop sessions.
- [Resources](/resources): Curated tools, libraries, and reading list.
- [Whitepaper](/whitepaper): UTAAB whitepaper.
- [Contributor Match](/contributor-match): Match contributors to open initiatives.
- [Education Home](/education): UTAAB Academy landing page.
- [Course Catalog](/education/courses): Browse all courses.
- [Blockchain and Money](/education/blockchain-and-money): Streamed MIT OCW course.
- [TonRa Project](/projects/tonra): TonRa project page.
- [UBpoint Project](/projects/ubpoint): UBpoint project page.
- [Verify Certificate](/verify-certificate): Public certificate verification.
